spans.s:
Uddhi denotes some part of a chariot, probably the seat, but, according to Roth, the frame resting on the axle.
Foot notes Av. viii. 8, 22; Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, xii. 2, 2, 2; aitareya Āraṇyaka, ii. 3, 8.
So Whitney's Translation of the Atharvaveda, 506; Eggeling, Sacred Books of the East, 44, 149.
St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
